params.name: cloudProvider
params.description: The cloud provider where the region is located. If specified, only regions of the specified cloud provider are returned.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the project to list regions for. If not specified, the project ID of the default project is used.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of regions to return. If not specified, at most 20 regions will be returned. The maximum value is `100`. Values greater than `100` are set to `100`.

params.name: pageToken
params.description:
The pagination token received from a previous [List regions](#tag/Region/operation/RegionService_ListRegions) request. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

**Note**: When paginating, all other parameters must match the original request.

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of regions to skip before returning results. If the value exceeds the total number of clusters, the response is `200` with an empty list and no `nextPageToken`.

items.docs: Lists the regions where you can create a cluster, across all supported cloud providers.

params.name: regionId
params.description: The ID of the region to retrieve, in the format of `{cloud_provider}-{region_code}`. For example, `aws-us-east-1`.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the project for which to retrieve the region. If not specified, the project ID of the default project is used.

items.docs: Retrieves details of a specific region by region ID.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the project. If not specified, the project ID of the default project is used.

items.docs: Lists the cloud providers available for creating a cluster.

params.name: regionId
params.description: The ID of the region, in the format of `{cloud_provider}-{region_code}`. For example, `aws-us-east-1`.

params.name: componentType
params.description: Filters the results to include only node specs for the specified component type.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Filters the results to include only node specs available to the specified project. If not specified, the project ID of the default project is used.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: Filters the results to include only node specs available to the specified cluster. If not specified, all available node specs are returned.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of node specs to return. If not specified, at most 10 node specs will be returned. The maximum value is `100`. Values greater than `100` are set to `100`.

params.name: pageToken
params.description:
The pagination token received from a previous [List node specs](#tag/Region/operation/RegionService_ListNodeSpecs) request. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

**Note**: When paginating, all other parameters must match the original request.

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of node specs to skip before returning results. If the value exceeds the total number of clusters, the response is `200` with an empty list and no `nextPageToken`.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of node specifications (specs) available for creating or scaling a cluster in the specified region. You can filter the results using the `componentType`, `projectId`, or `clusterId` parameter.

params.name: regionId
params.description: The region ID of the node spec to retrieve, in the format of `{cloud_provider}-{region_code}`. For example, `aws-us-east-1`. If not specified, the default region ID is used.

params.name: componentType
params.description: Filters the results to include only node specs for the specified component type.

params.name: nodeSpecKey
params.description: The key of the node spec to retrieve. For example, `8C32G`.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the project for which to retrieve the node spec. If not specified, the project ID of the default project is used.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: The ID of the cluster. If specified, only node specs that are available to the specified cluster are returned. If not specified, all available node specs are returned.

items.docs: Retrieves details of a node spec used for creating or scaling a cluster.
